metadata.publisher: IMPRIMERIE DE PAUL-ÉMILE CONI ET FILS

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features a strong contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and thin, horizontal serifs, which are the defining characteristics of the Didone style (popularized by Didot and Bodoni) common in late 19th-century formal printing.
